软弱变为刚强，争战显出勇敢，
打退外邦的全军。
滅了烈火的猛勢，脫了刀劍的鋒刃；
軟弱變為剛強，爭戰顯出勇敢，

Quenched the violence of fire
escaped the edge of the sword
out of weakness were made strong
waxed valiant in fight
turned to flight the armies of the aliens .
